source.label: Non-X first-party source hunt shard
constraints: Accepted evidence is native first-party company, founder, repo, video, comment, or launch URL.
Accepted evidence is not a profile, search page, or account-existence-only URL.
Accepted evidence has visible item-level metrics.
Exact source URLs are absent from both dedupe files at write time.
